sections.title: Returns
sections.sql: select tag,person,due_on,departed_on from v_custody where returned_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Support and renewals
sections.sql: select name,kind,due_on,owner from v_renewals order by due_on

sections.title: Physical observations
sections.sql: select tag,name,site,state,last_seen,days_unseen from v_stocktake order by tag

sections.title: Per-device records only
sections.note: Review actual contracts. Counts do not establish legal compliance.
sections.sql: select name,seats,installed,available,expires_on from v_licences order by name
